features.normalization: per-window mean / sample standard deviation, floor 1e-5

architecture:
MarvinV4(
  (stem): Sequential(
    (0): Conv2d(1, 48, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1), bias=False)
    (1): BatchNorm2d(48, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
    (2): ReLU()
  )
  (blocks): Sequential(
    (0): ResidualDSBlock(
      (depthwise): Conv2d(48, 48, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1), groups=48, bias=False)
      (dn): BatchNorm2d(48, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
      (pointwise): Conv2d(48, 48, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1), bias=False)
      (pn): BatchNorm2d(48, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
      (se): SqueezeExcitation(
        (reduce): Conv2d(48, 12, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
        (expand): Conv2d(12, 48, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
      )
      (skip): Identity()
    )
    (1): ResidualDSBlock(
      (depthwise): Conv2d(48, 48, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1), groups=48, bias=False)
      (dn): BatchNorm2d(48, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
      (pointwise): Conv2d(48, 96, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1), bias=False)
      (pn): BatchNorm2d(96, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
      (se): SqueezeExcitation(
        (reduce): Conv2d(96, 24, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
        (expand): Conv2d(24, 96, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
      )
      (skip): Sequential(
        (0): Conv2d(48, 96, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(2, 2), bias=False)
        (1): BatchNorm2d(96, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
      )
    )
    (2): ResidualDSBlock(
      (depthwise): Conv2d(96, 96, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1), groups=96, bias=False)
      (dn): BatchNorm2d(96, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
      (pointwise): Conv2d(96, 96, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1), bias=False)
      (pn): BatchNorm2d(96, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
      (se): SqueezeExcitation(
        (reduce): Conv2d(96, 24, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
        (expand): Conv2d(24, 96, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
      )
      (skip): Identity()
    )
    (3): ResidualDSBlock(
      (depthwise): Conv2d(96, 96, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(2, 2), dilation=(2, 2), groups=96, bias=False)
      (dn): BatchNorm2d(96, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
      (pointwise): Conv2d(96, 96, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1), bias=False)
      (pn): BatchNorm2d(96, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
      (se): SqueezeExcitation(
        (reduce): Conv2d(96, 24, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
        (expand): Conv2d(24, 96, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
      )
      (skip): Identity()
    )
    (4): ResidualDSBlock(
      (depthwise): Conv2d(96, 96, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1), groups=96, bias=False)
      (dn): BatchNorm2d(96, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
      (pointwise): Conv2d(96, 96, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1), bias=False)
      (pn): BatchNorm2d(96, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
      (se): SqueezeExcitation(
        (reduce): Conv2d(96, 24, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
        (expand): Conv2d(24, 96, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
      )
      (skip): Identity()
    )
  )
  (dropout): Dropout(p=0.2, inplace=False)
  (classifier): Linear(in_features=192, out_features=1, bias=True)
)

training.negatives: seeded full-pool cycling; no excluded words
training.checkpoint_selection: EMA model, validation F1 at validation-only FAR-constrained threshold
training.threshold_selection: maximum validation F1 subject to FAR<=cap; ties recall then fewer FP

streaming.score: max over adjacent pairs of min(sigmoid logits)
streaming.metric_unit: recording-placement event; NOT clip FAR or real-world FAR/hour
streaming.latency_note: recording end is not verified speech end
